findings.message: 3 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Muhammad Hassan Khan, Frontend & Creative Develo" → 4 lines (10 words, 37.4px); "Crafting fast, animated & intuitive web experien" → 3 lines (10 words, 57.6px); "Let's create something exceptional." → 3 lines (4 words, 109.4px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 16 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Available for work" (pill) above "Muhammad Hassan Khan, Frontend & Creativ"; "Skills" above "My toolkit, in orbit"; "Selected work" above "Projects that shipped"; "View project" above "ROX"; "View project" above "ONIC"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 22 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "About", "(01)", "Based in", "Focus").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 3 gradient fill(s): div.backdrop → radial-gradient(60% 40% at 25% 30%, rgba(255, 107, 26, 0.12), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%), radial-gradient(50% 45% a | div.hero__glow → radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 107, 26, 0.2), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 58%) | article.service.card → linear-gradient(160deg, rgb(255, 127, 48), rgb(240, 86, 10))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 6 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.tgrid__media → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 24px 90px 0px | div.tgrid__media → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 24px 90px 0px | div.tgrid__media → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 24px 90px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 7 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.marquee 1440px | ul.facts 758px | li 1224px | li 1224px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 14 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 9 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3, 4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: 1 clip(s) without a poster.
findings.fix: Give every clip a poster frame: in the study of 100 Sites of the Day only 31% had one, and the blank or grey boxes before the clips played were recorded as faults (references/imagery.md §11).

findings.message: 11 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 90px on the left, 51px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Frontend · Responsive" (11px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (108px, 574px, 48px, 137px, 562px, 90px, 448px); the three most used hold only 43% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Let's create something exceptional." (screen 11, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "Let's create something exceptional." → 3 lines (4 words, 58.4px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: The h1 is 24px ("Muhammad Hassan Khan, Frontend & Creative Develope").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: 3 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Muhammad Hassan Khan, Frontend & Creative Develo" → 4 lines (10 words, 24px); "Crafting fast, animated & intuitive web experien" → 4 lines (10 words, 30.4px); "Let's create something exceptional." → 3 lines (4 words, 41.6px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: 1 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 572px at 10144px (the screen is 844px tall).
findings.fix: A fixed picture layer covers the screen here, so the DOM cannot tell whether the stretch is empty: check the screenshots. Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 7 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "About", "Skills", "Work", "Services"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
